archetypes.name: dyn-trap-cleanup
archetypes.rationale: The change relies on Bash EXIT trap status preservation and marker cleanup ordering.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 3 wrapper trap changes for Bash EXIT semantics. Check that the new post-loop helper preserves the normalize-status exit code, disarms traps before cleanup, removes .bg-wait-active, and still guarantees eligible sentinels. Pay special attention to signal paths after the loop cleanup trap is replaced. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
